name: Hemispheric Rotation
definition: A 3D rotation technique for volumetric displays where rotation is initiated by touching the display with the dominant hand's index finger. Dragging the finger across the surface rotates the model as if a stick connects the finger to the model's center, providing two degrees of freedom. Twisting the hand while the finger remains down rotates the model about the vector from the finger to the model, providing the third degree of freedom.
